name: Dawning Isles
summary: The Dawning Isles are a cluster of low-lying islets situated within Lordamere Lake along the eastern edge of Silverpine Forest. Once idyllic retreats, they have succumbed to the blight of the Plague of Undeath and are overrun by aggressive murlocs.

sections.title: Blight on the Lake
sections.body: Before the Third War, the Dawning Isles were known as scenic keys resting on the calm, clear waters of Lordamere Lake. When the Plague of Undeath swept across Lordaeron, corruption seeped into the lake's shallows. The vegetation turned pallid and rotting, driving away idyllic peacefulness. Today, the Vile Fin murloc tribe dominates the muddy shores and tangled brush, aggressively defending their burgeoning colonies from anyone seeking to traverse the lake.

sections.title: A Murloc Stronghold
sections.body: Murlocs were not always the only danger on the isles. Bog beasts once prowled the blighted islets alongside them, but the bog beasts have since vanished. In their absence the Vile Fin population has swelled to the point that the murlocs now control the isles outright, turning what was once a quiet chain of keys into their stronghold on Lordamere Lake.

faq.q: Where are the Dawning Isles located?
faq.answer: The Dawning Isles are located in Lordamere Lake, bordering the eastern boundary of Silverpine Forest and resting just west of the Ruins of Lordaeron.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Dawning Isles?
faq.answer: The islands are primarily infested by the Vile Fin tribe of murlocs, which thrives along the corrupted shorelines. In the past, dangerous bog beasts also prowled the islets, though they have largely vanished in favor of the teeming murloc population.

faq.q: Why are the trees and shores rotting here?
faq.answer: The islands were tainted during the Third War when the Plague of Undeath swept Lordaeron. The water and soil absorbed the blight, poisoning the vegetation and leaving the islets murky, sickly, and decayed.

angles.text: The blighted Dawning Isles lie on Lordamere Lake, within sight of the western approaches to the Undercity, and the Vile Fin murlocs that hold them grow more numerous each year.
The blighted islands serve as a grim reminder of how far the corruption of the Scourge reached into Lordaeron's most scenic waters.
